title: Facebook for news — surveyed online Indians (Reuters DNR)

metadata.note: Reuters DNR India: mainly English-speaking, online news users; not nationally representative; under-represents TV/print and the offline/vernacular majority. India sample n approx 2,000; no education quota applied.
metadata.samplingBreak: DNR notes a sampling and weighting change from 2021 onwards; and from 2025 the 'Any online' source category was widened to include news podcasts, social/video networks and AI chatbots. Treat the 'online' and 'social media' source-category lines as approximate; TV, print and per-platform shares are the cleaner signals.
